purpose: Descriptive lookup of all published Song Table S4 candidate rsIDs in three existing datasets; no candidate selection based on results
selection: Exact rsID only, retain absent and duplicate matches, then require chromosome and position agreement before recording alignment
alignment: Only direct A1/A2 equality or swapped equality; no complement/strand imputation; exclude ambiguous A/T and C/G from interpreted directional comparisons; FFS effect column is source-inferred
filtering: No additional p-value, FDR, effect-size, direction, or result-dependent selection; dataset p values are source descriptive, no fresh inferential or scoring claim
limitation: Post-publication lookup, not a pre-registered study, independent replication, fine-mapping, causal colocalization, or validated risk score; FI and sleep samples share or may share UKB. Existing locus QC failure remains in force.
